name: Spreader 2
summary: Spreader 2 is a hedging EA that trades correlated instruments by opening opposing positions on two symbols simultaneously, aiming to profit from the convergence or divergence of their price spread. It calculates a dynamic spread between two instruments and enters trades when the spread deviates from its statistical norm, expecting mean reversion of the spread. The EA manages both legs of the hedge together, closing positions when the spread returns to target levels or when profit/loss thresholds are reached.
summary_zh: Spreader 2是一款对冲EA，通过在两个相关品种上同时开立反向仓位进行交易，利用它们价差的收敛或发散来获利。它动态计算两个品种之间的价差，当价差偏离统计常态时入场，期望价差均值回归。EA同时管理对冲的两个腿，当价差回归目标水平或达到盈亏阈值时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用统计套利/对冲策略，核心概念是在两个相关性较高的品种之间捕捉价差的异常偏离并进行交易。入场条件为当两个品种的标准化价差超过设定的阈值时，在价差偏大时做空强势品种做多弱势品种，在价差偏小时反向操作。出场条件为价差回归至均值或达到预设的止盈止损目标。仓位管理通常根据两个品种的波动率进行配比，以确保两条腿的市场风险敞口大致相等。资金管理通过设定最大持仓量、单笔最大亏损和总资金风险比例来控制整体风险。此外，EA可能包含动态调整阈值和仓位系数的机制，以适应市场环境的变化。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA employs a statistical arbitrage/hedging strategy, with the core concept of capturing abnormal deviations in the spread between two highly correlated instruments. Entry conditions trigger when the normalized spread between two symbols exceeds a configured threshold — going short on the stronger symbol and long on the weaker one when the spread widens, and reversing when the spread narrows beyond bounds. Exit conditions are met when the spread reverts to its mean or when predefined take-profit and stop-loss levels are hit. Position sizing is typically calibrated based on the volatility ratio of the two instruments to ensure roughly equal market exposure on both legs of the hedge. Money management controls overall risk through maximum position limits, per-trade maximum loss, and total capital risk percentage. Additionally, the EA may include mechanisms for dynamically adjusting thresholds and position coefficients to adapt to changing market conditions.

parameters.name: SpreadThreshold
parameters.description: 价差入场阈值（标准差倍数）

parameters.name: LookbackPeriod
parameters.description: 价差均值计算回望周期

pros: 利用两个相关品种的对冲关系，降低了单边市场方向性风险
策略逻辑基于统计学原理，价差均值回归具有理论支撑
通过双腿配比管理，可以有效控制净敞口，适合震荡市和不确定行情
pros_en: Reduces directional market risk by hedging between two correlated instruments
Strategy logic is grounded in statistical principles with theoretical backing for spread mean reversion
Effective net exposure control through leg ratio management, suitable for ranging and uncertain markets
cons: 品种相关性可能随时间变化而失效，导致对冲保护降低
两条腿的滑点和点差成本叠加，交易成本较高
在极端行情下两个品种可能同向大幅波动，对冲失效造成双倍亏损风险
cons_en: Correlation between instruments may break down over time, reducing hedging effectiveness
Cumulative slippage and spread costs on both legs result in high transaction costs
In extreme market conditions both instruments may move sharply in the same direction, causing double-sided losses when hedging fails
improvements: 增加动态相关性监控，当相关性低于阈值时自动暂停交易
加入协整检验以确认两个品种之间存在长期均衡关系
improvements_en: Add dynamic correlation monitoring that automatically pauses trading when correlation drops below a threshold
Incorporate cointegration testing to confirm a long-term equilibrium relationship exists between the two instruments

risk_points: 相关性破裂风险：两个品种的历史相关性可能在关键市场事件中突然失效
执行风险：两条腿无法同时成交可能导致单边敞口
滑点风险：在流动性不足时两腿的成交价格偏差可能侵蚀利润空间
risk_points_en: Correlation breakdown risk: historical correlation between two instruments may suddenly fail during key market events
Execution risk: inability to fill both legs simultaneously may result in one-sided exposure
Slippage risk: price deviation on both legs during low liquidity may erode profit margins
